messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "weight in children and teenagers"
set: ["weight in children and teenagers", "based on weight especially in children and teenagers", "check height and weight often in children", "monitor height and weight in children and adolescents regularly", "doses are based on weight in children", "used in children and adolescents under close medical supervision and at appropriate dosage", "treatment program includes diet, exercise, and weight control", "keep out of reach of children and pets", "include diet, exercise, weight control, and special medical care", "children tested 2 and 4 weeks after starting treatment", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "make the medication less appealing to children and pets", "maintaining a healthy weight", "avoid use in children younger than 12 years old", "child taking escitalopram should be checked for height and weight gain", "child's dose is based on the age and weight of the child"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
